question: Should this issue be resolved by accepting the `sessions.list`-backed dashboard builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should the widget wait for the broader `sessions.activity.*` contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127?
rationale: The UI request is coherent, but automation cannot choose the permanent product/API boundary for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent status semantics.

options.title: Review and land the linked builtin
options.body: Treat the open dashboard ops-widgets PR as the candidate solution after its source, proof, stack, and security/dependency blockers are resolved.

options.title: Wait for Gateway activity first
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers settle the richer `sessions.activity.*` API, then build the widget against that contract.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: If maintainers do not want this as a standalone task, preserve its details under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 and close only after that decision is explicit.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked builtin
recommendation.body: Treat the open dashboard ops-widgets PR as the candidate solution after its source, proof, stack, and security/dependency blockers are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the Control UI plugin-tab product surface introduced by the Logbook merge and the dashboard-bundling direction.
